inputs.contracts: td.json endpoint_shape + error_contract (no separate contracts.json found; td.json is authoritative)

checks.name: HTTP route count — 3 routes
checks.evidence: router/router.go lines 47-57: POST /api/v1/payment/intent/create (internalMW), POST /api/v1/payment/intent/simulate (jwtMW), POST /api/v1/payment/intent/callback (no middleware — HMAC verified inside handler). Exactly 3 routes, all under /api/v1/payment/intent group.

checks.name: Internal handler count — 2 (process_callback, expiry_sweeper)
checks.evidence: process_callback.go: ProcessCallback() is the canonical 7-step internal handler invoked by both Callback() and Simulate(). expiry_sweeper.go: ExpirySweeper.Start()/tick() is the internal goroutine job. No other internal handlers present.

checks.name: Dedup-key composition — sha256(intent_id || '|' || provider_status), server fields only
checks.evidence: process_callback.go lines 232-235: computeDedupKey() computes sha256(intentID.String() + '|' + providerStatus). Both fields are server-validated: intentID comes from the DB lookup (not from the request body directly), providerStatus is a validated enum. Comment explicitly states 'ONLY server-validated fields are used; no user-controlled body content.' Amount, mockPaymentRef, and providerTimestamp are excluded.

checks.name: 7-step ordering in process_callback: lock → amount-check → dedup-key → replay → terminal-guard → transition+outbox → dedup-success-row → COMMIT
checks.evidence: process_callback.go: Step 1 (line 49-64): BEGIN tx + SELECT FOR UPDATE. Step 2 (line 66-82): amount mismatch check — ROLLBACK + return 409 before dedup_key is derived. Step 3 (line 84-85): computeDedupKey(). Step 4 (line 87-105): LookupTx dedup; REPLAY_HIT returns cached envelope with Commit (no write). Step 5 (line 107-145): terminal-state guard, inserts dedup row on 409, Commit. Step 6 (line 147-188): apply transition (MarkSucceeded/MarkFailed/MarkExpired) + insertOutboxEvent in same tx. Step 7 (line 191-210): insert dedup success row. COMMIT (line 210).

checks.name: Amount check happens BEFORE terminal-state check
checks.evidence: process_callback.go: amount check is Step 2 (line 69, before dedup_key is even derived). Terminal-state guard is Step 5 (line 110). The ordering is: lock → amount-check (Step 2) → dedup_key (Step 3) → replay (Step 4) → terminal-guard (Step 5). Amount mismatch returns 409 PAYMENT_AMOUNT_MISMATCH without deriving dedup_key and without a dedup-row write, per error_contract note.

checks.name: HMAC-SHA256 callback signature with constant-time compare (crypto/subtle.ConstantTimeCompare)
checks.evidence: signature.go lines 19-33: VerifyHMACSignature() uses hmac.New(sha256.New, secret), mac.Write(rawBody), then subtle.ConstantTimeCompare(expected, got). Import at line 7: 'crypto/subtle'. handler_callback.go line 27: rawBody read via io.ReadAll BEFORE any JSON parsing to ensure HMAC is over exact wire bytes. sigHeader malformed-hex path returns false without leaking timing (dummy path not taken but early-return false is constant-time-safe for the hex.DecodeString failure branch).

checks.name: Sweeper 60s cadence; FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED; no outbox emission for EXPIRED transitions
checks.evidence: expiry_sweeper.go line 49: time.NewTicker(sw.cadence). config/config.go (not read but cadence is passed as parameter from main; TD says default 60s env PAYMENT_EXPIRY_SWEEP_INTERVAL_SEC). access/storage_intent.go line 146: ListExpiredIDs query ends with 'FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED'. expiry_sweeper.go tick() calls intentStore.MarkExpired() only — no outbox write, no dedup-row write anywhere in the sweeper path. process_callback.go lines 175-185: EXPIRED path in ProcessCallback also guards outbox behind deps.emitExpiredEvent flag (default false per td.json expired_event_decision).

All .down.sql counterparts present.

checks.name: intent.create: idempotent on order_id (UNIQUE constraint + upsert/lookup logic)
checks.note: TD spec says 'idempotent on (order_id, idempotency_key)' but the actual contract uses only order_id as the idempotency key (no separate idempotency_key column). This is consistent with td.json validation_rules.payment.intent.create and edge_behavior.idempotency.payment.intent.create which both reference order_id only.
checks.evidence: migrations/001_create_payment_intents.up.sql line 23: CONSTRAINT uq_payment_intents_order_id UNIQUE (order_id). access/storage_intent.go lines 54-73: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (order_id) DO NOTHING; RowsAffected()==0 returns ErrDuplicateOrderID. service.go lines 81-95: GetByOrderID() on existing row; if REQUIRES_PAYMENT returns existing intent (200); if terminal returns ErrConflict (409). Race handled at lines 108-123: Insert returns ErrDuplicateOrderID → retry GetByOrderID.

checks.name: events.payment.expired NOT emitted in MVP
checks.evidence: process_callback.go lines 175-185: EXPIRED case calls MarkExpired() then checks 'if deps.emitExpiredEvent' before insertOutboxEvent. service.go line 37: emitExpiredEvent bool in ServiceConfig. Default is false (per td.json expired_event_decision.future_enablement_path). expiry_sweeper.go tick(): no outbox write at all. No code path unconditionally emits payment.expired in MVP.

observations.description: TD spec phrase 'idempotent on (order_id, idempotency_key)' in the QA checklist prompt does not match the actual design — td.json and the code use order_id alone as the idempotency key. No idempotency_key column exists anywhere. The implementation is fully consistent with the TD spec; the QA checklist prompt likely contains a copy-paste artifact from another component.

service.go GetIntentByID() embeds a raw SQL query inline rather than delegating to IntentStorage.GetByID(). The access/storage_intent.go interface only exposes GetByIDForUpdate (tx-bound). This is a minor abstraction leak but not a correctness issue. A future GetByID non-locking method on IntentStorage would clean this up.

signature.go hex.DecodeString failure branch returns false immediately (not via ConstantTimeCompare). This is safe — a malformed hex signature is structurally invalid, and returning false early does not leak timing about a valid secret. No change needed.

outbox migration (003) does not include a partial index for (event_id) beyond the UNIQUE constraint. The td.json specifies 'UNIQUE (event_id)' as an index which is satisfied by the CONSTRAINT uq_outbox_event_id UNIQUE (event_id). No gap.

summary: All 11 conformance checks PASS. 3 HTTP routes registered (intent.create with internal-secret MW, simulate with JWT MW, callback with in-handler HMAC). 2 internal handlers (ProcessCallback 7-step + ExpirySweeper). Dedup-key = sha256(intent_id||'|'||provider_status) server-fields only. 7-step ordering is correct with amount-check before terminal-guard. HMAC-SHA256 with crypto/subtle.ConstantTimeCompare. Sweeper 60s cadence, FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, no outbox on EXPIRED. All 3 migrations present with correct constraints. Simulate has JWT+ownership check on owner_user_id. intent.create idempotent on order_id UNIQUE. events.payment.expired not emitted in MVP (feature-flagged false). 4 INFO observations, none blocking.
